title: Triangulo-{ErIII3} complex showing field supported slow magnetic relaxation

material_class.structural_family: triangulo-{Er3} o-vanillin cluster with two μ3-OH caps

synthesis.procedure: A methanolic solution of ErCl3·6H2O (1.0 mmol, 0.381 g in 15 mL) was added dropwise to a stirring methanol solution (50 mL) of o-vanillin (1 mmol, 0.152 g) and 2-aminomethylpyridine (1 mmol, 0.108 mL) in the presence of triethylamine (1 mmol, 0.101 mL). The mixture was refluxed for 4 h in an oil bath. The yellow solution was cooled to room temperature and filtered. Vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into the filtrate yielded X-ray-quality yellow block crystals, which were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeOH, and dried in air and vacuum.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: reflux in oil bath; diethyl ether vapor diffusion crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled, filtered; vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into the yellow filtrate gave yellow block crystals; washed with cold MeOH; dried in air and vacuum

properties.summary: Field-supported SMM with two-mode slow magnetic relaxation (LF below ~1 Hz and HF above ~100 Hz). DC χT/C0 falls from 84.4 at room temperature to 51.4 at 2.0 K, consistent with antiferromagnetic exchange on an isosceles Er3 triangle. Magnetization at 2.0 K and 7.0 T does not saturate. Fitted isotropic exchange: J/hc = 0.48 cm−1, J′/hc = −1.00 cm−1, geff = 1.15. Out-of-phase AC susceptibility is silent at BDC = 0 and appears under applied DC field, peaking near 0.3 T.
